adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous code did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and, on failure, executed a `console.error(...)` including the Zod error and the raw Microsoft response (`responseJson`). The diff replaces this with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, and removes the `if (!tokenResponse.success) { console.error(...) }` block entirely. The new helper throws a generic `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on parse failure and does not log or include the prior detailed context (Zod error + response body). That is a verifiable reduction in observability compared to the removed logging, with no equivalent detailed replacement shown in the diff.
